wins: Completed reconnaissance to map perimeter services and enumerate potential vectors within the single episode, yielding a solid reward of 80 despite no mission success flag.
Engaged mentor support 10 times, ensuring targeted coaching for remediation of gaps in lateral movement and persistence.
fails: Unable to advance past initial foothold due to repeated failure to sustain access/persistence, resulting in 0% success rate.
Missed opportunity to pivot to high-value assets; no lateral movement payload executed before episode termination.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was effective and rewarded, but the campaign stalled when persistence/lateral movement objectives were unmet, indicating a need for improved post-exploitation sequencing.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Persistence attempts repeatedly failed after establishing initial access, often due to missing privilege escalation or misconfigured payload delivery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to gather host key details and potential username guesses

skill_cards.if_condition: After initial shell access without elevated privileges
skill_cards.then_action: Execute linpeash or sudo -l enumeration to identify privilege escalation paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When persistence needs to be established on a Linux host
